name: app_top_errors_yesterday
description: Show top erroneous calls handled by an application since yesterday
template: Show top erroneous calls handled by '{{ application }}' application since yesterday

name: hup_calls_perf_2h
description: Show performance overview of all hup calls in the past 2 hours grouped by call name
template: Show performance overview of all hup calls in the past 2 hours group by call name

name: promo_http_avg_response
description: Average response time of promo HTTP calls handled by a cluster
template: What is the average response time of promo HTTP calls handled by Kubernetes cluster {{ cluster }}?

arguments.name: cluster
arguments.description: The name of the Kubernetes cluster

name: app_errorcode_count
description: Count of erroneous HTTP calls by call.tag.Errorcode handled by an application
template: Show count of erroneous HTTP calls by call.tag.Errorcode handled by '{{ application }}' application.

name: app_top_errors_10min
description: Top erroneous calls handled by an application in last 10 minutes
template: Show top erroneous calls handled by '{{ application }}' service since last 10 minutes.

name: cluster_outbound_http_perf
description: Performance overview of outbound HTTP calls from a Kubernetes cluster to an application
template: Show performance overview of outbound HTTP calls from kubernetes cluster {{ cluster }} to {{ destination_application }} application order by calls

name: queue_depth_check
description: Current queue depth of a given AMQ queue
template: What is the current queue depth of {{ queue_name }} from the queue manager running on namespace {{ namespace }}?

arguments.name: queue_name
arguments.description: The name of the AMQ queue

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.description: The namespace of the queue manager

name: jvm_threadpool_usage
description: Active thread usage of JVMs in a given namespace
template: Show active thread (threadPooL.activeThreads) usage of all JVMs belonging to deployment matching label component={{ component }} running within namespace {{ namespace }}?

name: container_limits_by_label
description: CPU and memory limits for containers in pods by label
template: Show me cpu and memory limits of all containers running inside pod with deployment label matching component={{ component_label }}.

name: jvm_memory_pool_usage
description: Memory pool usage for JVM in a specific container and namespace
template: Show me memory pool usage of JVM running inside appserver container of pod with kubernetes deployment label matching component={{ component_label }} and kubernetes namespace {{ namespace }}

name: replica_count_by_label
description: Replica count for deployments in a specific namespace by label
template: How many replicas do we have for deployments matching label service={{ service_label }} inside Kubernetes namespace {{ namespace }}?

name: heap_util_by_service_namespace
description: Average heap utilization of JVMs in a service and filtered namespaces
template: What is the average heap utilization of all JVMs having deployment label matching service={{ service_name }} and Kubernetes namespace name containing '{{ namespace_keyword }}'. Group the result by Kubernetes namespace value.

name: app_cve_latency_risks
description: Recommended actions or CVE risks causing latency in an application
template: Are there any recommended actions or CVE risks you can find for the '{{ application }}' application in my environment that might be causing poor latency on my endpoints for this application? Please use my tools

name: app_top_errors_yesterday_local
description: Top erroneous calls for an application since yesterday using local tool
template: Show top erroneous calls handled by '{{ application }}' application in my environment since yesterday using local tool

name: slowest_apis_local_tool
description: Slowest API endpoints and their contributing factors using local tool only
template: What are the slowest API endpoints in my environment and their contributing factors (CPU, memory, dependencies) - use local tool only

name: compare_app_perf_cost_cve
description: Compare performance and cost efficiency of multiple apps with CVE checks
template: Compare the performance and cost efficiency of the {{ app1 }}, {{ app2 }}, and {{ app3 }} applications running across different clusters. Identify which app has the worst latency-to-cost ratio, and check if there are any known CVEs associated with their public endpoints or container images.
